name: Free Duplicate Tag Removal
author: QliqQliq

sections.description:
Free Duplicate Tag Removal is a lightweight and effective plugin designed to help you maintain clean and organized HTML content on your WordPress site. This powerful tool quickly identifies and removes duplicate HTML tags (such as headings, paragraphs, and buttons), ensuring that your content is optimized for better SEO and readability.

Key Features:

  • Automatic Cleanup: Effortlessly cleans your content by removing duplicate tags.
  • SEO Friendly: Improves your site’s SEO performance by streamlining HTML structure.
  • User-Friendly: Simple installation and intuitive settings interface.
  • Lightweight: Minimal impact on site performance.
  • Select2 Integration: Utilizes the Select2 library for enhanced select functionality.
  • Translatable: The plugin is fully translatable to French (Canada) languages.

Acknowledgements

This plugin is inspired by the need for cleaner HTML content and improved SEO practices within the WordPress community. We appreciate the feedback and support from our users.

License

Contact

For support or inquiries, please reach out to us at contact@qliqqliq.com. We’re here to help! Visit our website at qliqqliq.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Free Duplicate Tag Removal folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Free Duplicate Tag Removal settings page to manage tag cleanup options as needed.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

Free Duplicate Tag Removal removes duplicate HTML tags from your content, enhancing both SEO and readability.

Will this affect my existing tags?

No, Free Duplicate Tag Removal specifically cleans up HTML tags and does not modify your WordPress tag database.

How does Free Duplicate Tag Removal use the Select2 library?

Free Duplicate Tag Removal incorporates the Select2 library to provide a user-friendly multi-select interface, enhancing your ability to manage tag exclusions.

How do I report a bug or request a feature?

You can report bugs or request features through the support forum or contact us directly at contact@qliqqliq.com.
